record.original_question: Let G be a right-angled Artin group. Is the stable commutator length scl(g) a rational number for every g ∈ [G, G]? For free groups this is true by Calegari’s Rationality Theorem. (See 18.40 for the definition of scl(g).)

evidence.quote: Let G be a right-angled Artin group. Is the stable commutator length scl(g) a rational number for every g ∈ [G, G]? For free groups this is true by Calegari’s Rationality Theorem. (See 18.40 for the definition of scl(g).)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let Γ be a finite simple graph with vertex set V and edge set E. The right-angled Artin group associated with Γ is the group
   A(Γ) = ⟨ V | [v, w] = 1 for all {v, w} ∈ E ⟩.
For a group G and an element g in the commutator subgroup [G, G], the commutator length cl_G(g) is the least integer n ≥ 0 such that g can be written as a product of n commutators in G. The stable commutator length of g is defined by
   scl_G(g) = lim_{n → ∞} cl_G(g^n) / n.
(The limit exists since cl_G(g^n) is subadditive in n.)

Question: Let G = A(Γ) be a right-angled Artin group. Is it true that for every g ∈ [G, G], the stable commutator length scl_G(g) is a rational number?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Chen–Heuer 2020, "Stable commutator length in right-angled Artin and Coxeter groups") establishes spectral gap results and shows every rational q ≥ 1 arises as scl of some integral chain in a RAAG, but does not resolve whether scl is rational for every element of [G,G] in every RAAG. The rationality question for elements of right-angled Artin groups appears to remain open beyond the free group case (Calegari's Rationality Theorem).

status_evidence.title: Stable commutator length in right-angled Artin and Coxeter groups
status_evidence.snippet: Every rational q ≥ 1 arises as scl of an integral chain in some RAAG; spectral gap results, but rationality of scl on elements not established in general.
status_evidence.claim: Recent results address spectral gaps and chain values but do not prove rationality of scl for all elements of every RAAG.

status_evidence.title: Gaps in scl for Amalgamated Free Products and RAAGs
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes a uniform 1/2 gap for scl of elements in RAAGs.
status_evidence.claim: Gap results known, but not full rationality.
